summary: QRU Book Manufacturing – Publish tab UI: full end-to-end Founder workflow verified for book id a5f36f1e-1eb0-4cc7-886f-d6c86d9c8af6 (which is 'Ordinary Tuesdays FULL MANUSCRIPT · BOOK-0003' in the current DB, not 'The Understanding Tree · BOOK-0001' as the request suggested — see data-mismatch note below; but the book is still a 48-page fiction title so every Publish assertion is valid). All 9 requested Founder-journey steps PASS with one WARNING on the authorize button UI honesty.

founder_journey_9_step_verdict.2_pricing_advisor_get_recommendation: PASS — GET /pricing-advisor?paper_type=white returns full recommendation. UI shows rec-ebook-price $5.99, rec-paperback-price $15.99, est. royalty (eBook $4.19 @ 70% + PB $7.29 · print $2.30), price-position 'Standard', confidence-level 'Medium', comparable range (eBook $4.99–$7.99 / PB $13.99–$17.99) with basis, and AI-authored Founder Notes. POST /pricing-scenarios returns 200 with 3 scenarios. scenario-table renders 3 rows with columns Price, PB royalty, Margin %, eBook royalty (with rate 70% or 35%), Position (Budget/Standard/Premium). founder_journey_9_step_verdict.4_back_cover_blurb_draft_edit_approve: PASS — Draft with AI populated a fresh ~880-char blurb in ~15s (LLM-generated). blurb-status chip reads 'draft — Founder to approve'. Textarea is editable, include-blurb-toggle toggles True/False cleanly, Save & Approve persists the edited blurb and the chip flips to 'approved by Founder'.
founder_journey_9_step_verdict.5_kdp_print_ready_cover_wrap: PASS — Build Print-Ready Wrap returned in ~20s. wrap-result shows Pages: 48, Paper: white, Spine: 0.1081", Trim: 6 x 9 in, Full size: 12.358 x 9.25 in, DPI: 300. spine-note honestly says 'Spine left blank (KDP requires ≥ 79 pages for spine text).' wrap-preview image renders. download-wrap-pdf href = /api/rendering/asset/book-cover-wrap-*.pdf and directly downloads a real 512 KB PDF (application/pdf, HTTP 200). Description line under the download reads 'Back cover + spine + front cover (complete wrap).' — this is a genuine full wrap, not a front-only cover.
founder_journey_9_step_verdict.6_master_output_package_assemble: PASS — assemble-package-btn works (was already assembled earlier; Factory Library shows 'Master Output Package · 6780 KB' with Download button that opens the .zip). Real byte size, real provenance stamp ('by Erica Talbert 7/15/2026, 5:43:01 AM').
founder_journey_9_step_verdict.7_ready_for_kdp_checklist: PASS — kdp-panel renders 20 fields with clear status markers: ✓ confirmed, ○ needs founder (ISBN, List price), ~ suggested (Categories BISAC 'Suggested from genre Fiction — confirm 2 on KDP', Keywords). Book description/blurb field correctly reflects the edited blurb text. Legend line at bottom explains ✓ / ~ / ○ meanings.
founder_journey_9_step_verdict.8_authorize_release_founder_gate: PASS (with 1 UI-honesty WARNING) — release-gate renders all 11 gate items with Pending/✓ chips. gate-ready chip reads 'Gate not yet ready' when Title Author, Rights Confirmed, Pricing Approved, and Founder Authorization Received are still Pending. authorize-btn IS present and renders. When clicked while gate is not ready, backend correctly returns HTTP 400 with detail 'Cannot authorize — unmet gate items: title author, rights confirmed, pricing approved.' which the UI surfaces as a toast. So the Treasure Standard is enforced server-side. UI-honesty WARNING: the button remains ENABLED (disabled={busy} only) even when the gate is not ready — the Founder can click it and only learns of the block via the toast response. See action_items.
founder_journey_9_step_verdict.9_clarity_of_communication: PASS overall. Labels, honesty notes, and status chips are clear and consistent (StatusChip components, colour-coded tone). Only two minor clarity issues: (a) gate item 'Title Author' reads as one combined field — display label should be 'Title & Author'; (b) 'AI Disclosures Completed' now capitalises AI correctly (fixed since iteration 76 — verified). The panel top banner on the Pricing Advisor uses honest language and the disclaimer under the PB approval button repeats it explicitly.

ui_bugs.issue: authorize-btn is only disabled while busy; it stays clickable even when data.gate_ready === false. Server correctly blocks with 400 + honest error message, so no illegal state is created — but the UI is one step behind the Treasure Standard: the button should render disabled (or as a StatusChip) while the gate is not ready, and the friction should be signalled BEFORE the click, not after. Recommended fix at BookManufacturing.js:972: disabled={busy || !data.gate_ready}

issues: Gate item 'Title Author' is a run-on label (snake_case key 'title_author' → 'Title Author'). Consider rendering it as 'Title & Author' in the label mapper at BookManufacturing.js:949.
Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — likely a decorative <span> inside a book-switcher <option>. Non-blocking but noisy in DevTools.

frontend_issues.data_mismatch_note: The review request describes book id a5f36f1e-1eb0-4cc7-886f-d6c86d9c8af6 as 'BOOK-0001 The Understanding Tree', but in the current preview DB that id resolves to 'Ordinary Tuesdays FULL MANUSCRIPT · BOOK-0003' (48 pp, 17,576 words, fiction — still a valid 48-page fiction title). 'The Understanding Tree · BOOK-0001' exists under a different id (starts 8469bcc5-…). The Publish workflow itself works correctly on the requested id; the mismatch is only in the human-readable title description in the request. Recommend the main agent confirm which book was intended before shipping.

action_items: MEDIUM: Disable authorize-btn when data.gate_ready === false to reflect the Treasure Standard proactively (BookManufacturing.js:972). Server-side gate check is already correct.
LOW cosmetic: relabel gate item 'Title Author' → 'Title & Author' in gate-items renderer (line ~949).
LOW: fix DOM nesting warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') in the book-switcher option template.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicationDetailsPanel useEffect resets both blurb and include on any change to book?.description or book?.include_blurb. That means if a Founder is mid-edit and a background reload() lands (e.g. after another action), their in-flight edits are silently discarded. Consider tracking a 'dirty' flag or only resetting when book.id changes.

PrintWrapPanel busy-state is shared with the whole page (top-level busy prop). If a Founder triggers Draft Blurb, the Print-Ready Wrap button also disables. Minor UX friction on a page with many concurrent operations.

PublishPanel: authorize-btn disabled logic ignores data.gate_ready (only checks busy). Server enforces the gate honestly, but the UI should not offer a click that will fail — that's a Treasure Standard clarity gap.
Publication scenario-input has no client-side validation for non-numeric input; filter(Boolean) will silently drop invalid entries. A red-inline hint for skipped tokens would help clarity.
book-switcher <option> contains a decorative <span> — invalid HTML. React logs a hydration warning.

rca of the issue: authorize-btn UI honesty: BookManufacturing.js line 972 declares `disabled={busy}`. It should include the gate condition: `disabled={busy || !data.gate_ready}`. The backend at /book-mfg/books/{id}/authorize already enforces this contract and returns HTTP 400 with a specific 'Cannot authorize — unmet gate items: ...' message, but the Founder should not be able to click through to that failure — the Treasure Standard prefers preventing false hope over correcting it after the fact.
